source_offsets: Python Unicode character indexes; half-open [start,end); exact match against original user message
timestamps: recorded_at is an aware ISO-8601 timestamp; event_time.raw preserves user wording, start/end may remain null; no inferred calendar date or automatic expiry
identity: owner and session must match the source message; family labels are relationships, not resolved real-world identities
semantics_boundary: This contract validates structure and source span identity, not the natural-language truth or meaning of a supplied value, subject, mode, intent or event linkage. Stage B must verify extraction and intent before production use.
persistence_boundary: Pure validation and decision only. No database, memory collection, vector indexing, message sending, real-model call or lifecycle mutation. Cross-session applicability and user permissions are enforced by future production adapters.
event_linking: An event transition requires matching non-null event_id and subject/attribute; a disease name alone is insufficient. Ambiguous event linkage yields clarify.
history_policy: replace_effective marks a future logical relationship; it never instructs deletion of historical records. resolved is a user-reported event state, not medical confirmation.
